steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the case.
Provide the mandatory event title so the event can be published.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add one product matching the requested CYLINDER item.
Populate the remaining pricing-sheet fields so the sheet is rendered and publishable.
Enter the very large quantity into the first line item.
Verify the quantity remains present with thousands separators after entry.
Check that the sheet shows no NaN, undefined, overflow-like values, server error, or crash after the large quantity is entered.
Invite one available QA vendor so publication can proceed.
Publish the RFQ after completing its required setup.
Assert that publication reached a real event page.
Confirm publishing did not produce an application error.
Check the published event page for crashes, server errors, or broken numeric rendering.
